conventions.size: fillet radius or equal-offset chamfer distance (Onshape EQUAL_OFFSETS: setback d along each support face, probe FP-a / FP15)
conventions.select: near: the edge within 1e-6 mm of the point; all; parallel: straight edges parallel to the axis; inPlane: edges lying in the plane; segment: edges lying on the segment
conventions.closedForm: deltaVolume = result volume - input volume (negative = material removed), from the design parameters; job: {kind} re-evaluates it on the job geometry (scripts/fillet/closedform.mjs), which grades the result
conventions.rank: edge-configuration rank in docs/fillet/corpus.md §4.1 (99 = not measured in the corpus)
